items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Well when orchestra playing I think I come more closest to Faisal. That's the guy I like and that's the one I come up close to.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well whose style did you say you came to, you come the closest to of all the people you've heard when you were growing up?

Well when orchestra playing I think I come more closest to Faisal. That's the guy I like and that's the one I come up close to. During said bass drum I was the only one come close to Black Benny I guess you heard of him.
Oh yeah. Well you like Black Benny's.
